plays.desc_ko: 레스트와 포우트가 2인 플레이로 카밀(카나)을 잡으려 했으나 카나가 일단 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: Rest (Ambessa) and Pout (Ryze) try a two-man catch on Canna (Camille), but she escapes for now.
plays.quote: potential twoman play from Rest and Pout ... trying to catch the Camille. kind of ... gets away for now

plays.desc_ko: CFO가 바론 지역으로 돌아가 장악(도고가 '비장의 한 발'로 부시오 체력 약 25% 깎음), 카나 처치 후 바론을 공략. 레스트가 이이크를 막기 위해 즉시 진입하고 바론 처치, 이이크까지 추가 처치.
plays.desc_en: CFO retakes the Baron area as Doggo's Ace in the Hole chunks Busio for about 25%; after Canna falls, Rest dives in to block Yike, CFO takes Baron and also kills Yike.
plays.quote: Okay, there's that ace ... you know, 25% of Booio's health now ... CFO heading back to the Baron pit

plays.desc_ko: 바론 지역에서 카나가 날아들어 포우트에게 마법공학 최후통첩, 이이크가 대격변으로 후속. 키노가 제때 와서 미드라이너를 살림. 회고: 바론 교전은 카나와 이이크의 포우트 다이브로 시작되었고 카나는 포우트 킬에 실패.
plays.desc_en: At Baron, Canna (Camille) flies onto Pout (Ryze) with Hextech Ultimatum and Yike (Pantheon) follows with Grand Starfall, but Kino arrives in time to save his mid laner, and Canna fails to get the kill.
plays.quote: flies in. He puts the hex tech ultimatum ... on pout. Yikes. Ready to follow it up ... up in time to keep his mid laner alive.

plays.desc_ko: CFO가 방어로 전환, 도망치는 카나를 도고가 그물+헤드샷으로 처치 — KC의 '레이드 보스' 제거.
plays.desc_en: CFO turns defensive, and Doggo (Caitlyn) catches the fleeing Canna with net and headshot, taking down KC's raid boss.
plays.quote: And now CFO are on the defense. Connor ... tries to get away, but Doggo's RIGHT ... THERE WITH A 90 CALIBER NET AND A 50

plays.desc_ko: 바론 직후 반격: 야후가 벽 너머 점멸 후 한 명을 잡고, 칼리스테가 광폭하게 싸우며 야후 더블킬로 교전이 KC 쪽으로 기움. 섀도우는 도주 시도, 부활한 카나가 순간이동으로 도착해 도망치는 리 신을 쫓아 현상금(셧다운) 획득. 해설은 '바론 피바다'로 묘사.
plays.desc_en: Right after Baron, Kyeahoo (Viktor) flashes over a wall for a pick and Caliste (Yunara) fights ferociously as Kyeahoo gets a double kill; the respawned Canna teleports in to chase down Shad0w (Lee Sin) for a shutdown in what the casters call a Baron bloodbath.
plays.quote: YAHOO FLASHES OVER THE WALL, ... BUT HE GETS ONE BACK. ... NOW KALIST IS TRYING TO GO BERSERK MODE.

plays.desc_ko: 대양 영혼 드래곤 앞 교전: 카나가 도고가 너무 앞에 나왔다고 판단해 진입, 룰루의 급성장(Wild Growth)을 받고 이이크가 대격변으로 진입했으나 요들 덫에 걸림. 도고는 점멸·유체화 없이 스턴을 피했고 섀도우의 발차기로 합류가 완전히 끊김. KC는 후퇴, 양측 큰 피해 없음.
plays.desc_en: Before Ocean Soul, Canna (Camille) engages on an overextended Doggo with Lulu's Wild Growth and Yike's Grand Starfall, but Yike lands in a Yordle Snap Trap, Doggo dodges the stun without Flash or Ghost, and Shad0w's kick cuts off the follow-up; KC retreats without major losses.
plays.quote: river. DOGGO HAVING TO GET BACK. ... receives the wild growth as Yike flies ... Yortal Snap Trap. KZ trying to get away

plays.desc_ko: 교전 후 CFO가 카나를 찾아다니다 측면에서 포착, 레스트가 와드를 지우던 카나를 잡고 도고가 추가 피해; 카밀은 큰 피해와 함께 스테락 보호막을 잃고 영혼 교전에서 이탈.
plays.desc_en: CFO hunts Canna and spots her on the flank; Rest catches her clearing wards and Doggo adds damage, stripping Camille's Sterak's shield and forcing her out of the soul fight.
plays.quote: prowling around seeing if they can find ... Kana. They've got him on the side here. ... A lot of damage onto the Camille and he

plays.desc_en: KC keeps mid pressure during the soul fight and hits CFO's mid outer tower, but it survives on 5 health.
plays.quote: just going to keep the pressure on the ... mid lane. They'll take the tier one ... their tier one turret stays standing

plays.desc_ko: 교전에서 이긴 CFO가 바텀 강가를 장악, KC는 경합하지 않고 CFO가 대양 영혼 획득.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, CFO controls bot river and takes Ocean Soul uncontested.
plays.quote: turret there, but it's CFO after winning ... the fight that control the bottom side ... KC aren't even going to contest.

plays.desc_ko: 영혼 획득 후 카나가 바텀에서 포우트에게 마법공학 최후통첩으로 진입, CFO가 흩어져 있을 것으로 판단했으나 오판.
plays.desc_en: After soul, Canna (Camille) engages onto Pout (Ryze) bot with Hextech Ultimatum, misreading CFO as scattered.
plays.quote: bottom lane now though with a hex tech ... ultimatum going in AFTER POUT. ... HE THOUGHT CFO WERE GOING TO BE MORE

plays.desc_ko: 섀도우가 미드라이너를 지키기 위해 진입, 음파·공명의 일격·용의 분노로 카나를 쓰러뜨림(카나 30초 사망). 라이즈는 시커의 팔목 보호대도 쓰지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Shad0w (Lee Sin) jumps in to protect his mid laner, killing Canna with Sonic Wave, Resonating Strike and Dragon's Rage for a 30-second death timer; Ryze doesn't even need Seeker's Armguard.
plays.quote: JUMPS IN TO PROTECT HIS MID LANER. SONIC ... WAVE, RESONATING STRIKE, DRAGON'S RAGE ... TO KNOCK IT DOWN. AND KANA JUST GIFT

plays.desc_ko: 카나 사망과 영혼을 바탕으로 CFO가 KC 기지로 진입, 3차 타워를 쉽게 파괴하고 KC는 4대5 방어를 피하며 억제기를 내줌(바텀 억제기).
plays.desc_en: With Canna dead and soul in hand, CFO pushes into KC's base, easily takes the inner tower, and KC concedes the bot inhibitor rather than fight 4v5.
plays.quote: seconds. and CFO see the opportunity to ... go straight into the enemy base. Tier ... three turret should be knocked down

plays.desc_en: Fresh off respawn, Caliste (Yunara) slows Doggo, gets Lulu's ultimate and flashes in at his own risk; Doggo stalls with Seeker's Armguard but dies, and Yike (Pantheon) finishes the fleeing Rest as KC wins a 3-for-1.
plays.quote: BACK TO LIFE. DOGGO UNDER PRESSURE. ... KALIS TRYING TO GO IN WITH THE ARC OF ... DONGO STAYS ALIVE WITH THE SEEKER'S ARM

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 KC가 바론을 획득해 억제기 열세에도 맵 운영이 가능해짐.
plays.desc_en: After the fight, KC takes Baron, letting them play the map despite the inhibitor deficit.
plays.quote: your way out. KC, they do just that. ... They get the Baron for themselves. ... the Baron buff, they can play the map.

plays.desc_ko: KC가 장로 드래곤 교전을 앞두고 CFO 레드 진영 정글에 다수의 와드를 설치해 깊은 시야 확보.
plays.desc_en: Ahead of the Elder fight, KC places multiple wards in CFO's red-side jungle for deep vision.
plays.quote: like setup will be so critical. KC is ... already around the area. Look at all the ... red wards in the red side jungle of CFO.

plays.desc_ko: 레스트가 바텀 웨이브를 밀어넣고 귀환.
plays.desc_en: Rest (Ambessa) shoves the bot wave and recalls.
plays.quote: can see rest getting the bottom wave ... shoved up. Taking his recall now.

plays.desc_ko: 카나도 탑에서 같은 방식으로 웨이브를 밀고 귀환; KC는 바론 버프의 강화 귀환으로 최종 구매 예정.
plays.desc_en: Canna (Camille) does the same top, as KC uses Baron's empowered recall for final purchases.
plays.quote: Kana ... doing the same thing up there in the top ... empowered recalls now. They'll go back

plays.desc_ko: 장로 드래곤 20초 전 CFO가 지역 우선권 확보, 도고가 삼거리 부쉬에 덫 라인 설치; 제어 와드+덫으로 KC 접근을 어렵게 만듦. 포우트가 공간 왜곡 사용(목적 불명확).

plays.quote: CFO have priority over the area. ... away. Trap line being placed down in the ... tri brush here by Doggo.

plays.desc_ko: 카나가 순간이동으로 적 진영 뒤로 이동, 버티려던 도고가 칼리스테에게서 벗어나려 하나 카나 압박까지 받음. 칼리스테와 도고 모두 쓰러져 원딜 없는 4대4로 전개.
plays.desc_en: Canna (Camille) teleports behind CFO, and Doggo, trying to escape Caliste, is also pressured by Canna; both Caliste and Doggo fall, leading to a 4v4 with no ADCs.
plays.quote: a whole lot of that. Connor tping back ... behind enemy lines. Doggo ready to try ... to stand and fight. He tries to get AWAY

plays.desc_ko: KC가 장로 드래곤 구역을 장악하고 원딜 없이 천천히 장로를 침(그 사이 빅토르는 바텀 웨이브를 밀어둠). 이이크 스턴·야후 중력장으로 레스트를 몰아붙여 점멸로 도주시키고 CFO를 후퇴시킴; 카나가 다인 스턴을 노리고 진입했으나 용의 분노에 밀려남. 장로 체력 3000에서 리셋되어 양측 철수, 드래곤 미획득.
plays.desc_en: KC controls the pit and slowly hits Elder without an ADC while Viktor pushes bot; Yike's stun and Kyeahoo's Gravity Field force Rest to Flash and CFO back, but Canna's engage is kicked away by Dragon's Rage and Elder resets at 3000 health with neither team taking it.
plays.quote: his HP. KC with control over the Elder ... this dragon is going to fall slowly. ... taking a stun there from Yike.

plays.desc_en: Shad0w (Lee Sin) heals up on Krugs and returns, landing Sonic Wave and Dragon's Rage to push back Canna as CFO holds the line and stalls Elder until their ADC respawns.
plays.quote: grab the kugs. He's now going to regroup ... the outer dragon. Sonic wave has already ... KNOCKED BACK RIGHT BACK AWAY HERE with

plays.title_en: Pick on Lee Sin While Sweeping

plays.quote: SHADOW THOUGH. HE GETS CAUGHT RIGHT WHEN ... HE'S TRYING TO CLEAR OUT A LITTLE BIT OF ... VISION. SHADOW DIES.

plays.desc_ko: 섀도우 사망 후 CFO가 4대5로 반격 시도, 장로 체력 절반 상황에서 레스트·포우트가 전방에 섰지만 카나 측면 진입에 밀리고 레스트의 다이브도 패배.
plays.desc_en: Down Shad0w, CFO tries a 4v5 with Elder at half health; Rest and Pout front up but are pushed back by Canna's flank, and Rest's dive also fails.
plays.quote: available. CFO look to fight back. ... CFO with the 4v5. Dragon at half HP. ... Rest and pout here in the front line.

plays.desc_en: Canna (Camille) flanks into the backline with Hextech Ultimatum as KC counterattacks in the Elder fight and secures the Elder buff, with Canna fighting on at low health.
plays.quote: But the flank is COMING AROUND FROM K ... TRAPPED INSIDE THE HEXUM. ... DOGGO EXECUTE ON

plays.desc_ko: 장로·교전 승리 후 KC가 넥서스까지 밀어 게임 승리, 시리즈 2:0으로 CFO 탈락. 넥서스 파괴 장면 자체는 실황 묘사 없이 요약으로만 언급.
plays.desc_en: After winning Elder and the fight, KC pushes to the Nexus to win the game, taking the series 2-0 and eliminating CFO.
plays.quote: THEY WILL TAKE ... guarantee the team fight, GUARANTEE THE ... NEX
